text: What I eat in a day as a girl who follows a high protein plant-based diet. For breakfast, I had my signature protein cheer pudding. I am definitely on a cheer pudding cake right now. In an iced matcha latte made with almond milk and honey. For a snack, I had apples with peanut butter and jelly. This combo is unreal. I am truly obsessed with it. Lunch was one of my favorite meal preps, spring roll salad jars, with tofu, edamame, cucumber, red bell peppers, kelp noodles, carrots, cabbage, green onion, cilantro, mint, chopped peanuts, and a squeeze of lime in there. It is so fresh and so good. I love salad jars. Definitely on a salad jar cake right now. They're great for meal prep. And on a walk, I brought a protein bar for some extra fuel in the afternoon to tie me over before dinner. And for dinner, I made pea pesto with protein pasta topped with vegan Parmesan. I've been loving pea pesto. Recently, let me know if you want the recipe on this. And I ended my night with protein brownies topped with whipped cream and berries.
